A map of what it physically takes to produce and operate AI, from mined material to end demand. Read left to right: primary inputs become chips, chips become systems, systems are installed in powered buildings, buildings become compute supply, compute becomes a model, the model becomes a served product, and demand returns capital to the start. The band along the bottom applies to every tier at once. Almost nothing here is independent — each tier sets the cost and the schedule of the ones after it. Click a block for its record: what the block does operationally, why it is important, the tailwinds behind it now, and the headwinds against it, each with sources. The links inside a record open the coupling between two blocks rather than jumping away. Move the epoch slider to redraw the sheet as the system existed at one of ten moments between 2006 and 2026: blocks that were not yet a distinct activity fade to ghosts, couplings that did not yet exist drop out, and the era's binding constraint is outlined. A block's record gains a line on what it was doing at that moment, plus its own advancement timeline of the four to six moments that changed it, with the entries for the selected epoch marked and later ones faded. Return the slider to Today for the present-day sheet. Coupling records carry the same treatment: what the line was when it started, and how the relationship changed. Double-click any block — or press S on it, or use the button in its record — to open its sub-map: the same kind of drawing again, one level down, showing the internal stages of that single block and what binds inside it.

Lead times, concentrations and capacity figures reflect public reporting as of August 2026 and change quickly.
Block records cite the sources they draw on; analyst estimates and company guidance are labelled as such and are not facts. Educational framework only — not investment advice.
Block numbering runs PWE-14 to SIT-16: identifier 15 is reserved and intentionally unassigned, not a gap in the record — no block was removed or renumbered.
